text: Re-audited the external gate after completing parity and performance. No edf2asc, libedfapi, EDF headers, or permitted real EDF are present in the repo or standard macOS SDK locations. Official SR Research documentation confirms EDF2ASC and EDF Access API ship in the EyeLink Developers Kit, while the support download area requires account access: https://www.sr-research.com/download/dispdoc/page25.html and https://www.sr-research.com/support/index.php. The portable extractor, CRAN eyelinker 0.2.2 oracle, compiler ABI stub, hashes, and mutation proof remain valid, but they cannot be relabelled as a vendor EDF API runtime result. Required external inputs remain: an authorized Developers Kit/EDF API installation and a permitted real EDF fixture (or generated manifests plus complete converter/API provenance).
